title: Zindaan ke zulmatou me sakina guzar gayi
body:
ZINDAAN KE ZULMATOU MEIN SAKINA GUZAR GAYI
KYA KYA SITAM UTHAYE THE KARBAL SE SHAAM TAK, KITNE TAMACHE KHAYE THE KARBAL SE SHAAM TAK, WAADE MAGAR NIBHAYE THE KARBAL SE SHAAM TAK, KITNA BULANDH SABR KA MEYAR KARGAYI
EK SHAAM WA HUSSAIN KA BARPA THA QAID MEIN, AUR DAM HAR EK BIBI KA GHUT TA THA QAID MEIN, ALLAH KYA GAZAB KA ANDHERA THA QAID MEIN, KUNBE KO QAIDE ZULM SE AZAAD KARGAYI
BECHARGI HAI KHAUF HAI GHURBAT HAI YAAS HAI, BACCHI KE KHUSHK HOTOU PA SHIDDAT KI PYAS HAI, BEHRE KAFAN BADAN MEIN PHATA EK LIBAS HAI, MANZAR YE SAARE RAAT NIGAHO MEIN BHAR GAYI
<<DIVIDER>>
BABA KE QATAL HONE KA MANZAR LIYE HUE, NHANE SE DIL PA SADMAYE AKBAR LIYE HUE, AANKHOU MEIN AANSU KE SAMADAR LIYE HUE, JO BEE RAHI THI QAID MEIN GHUT GHUT KE MARGAYI
EHSAAS KI NIGAAH SEDEKHA HAI YE SAMAA, QAIDE SITAM MEIN AAJ BHI BAITHI HAI BIBIYAAN, AB TAK SUNAYI DETI HAI BACCHI KI HICHKIYAA, HAR SAHEBE ZAMEER KO BEDAAR KARGAYI
PATHAR LAHOO UGALTE THE LARZA THI KAYENAT, AYI PAHAD BANKE YATEEMI KI PEHLI RAAT, WO GAAL PHOOL JAISE WO ZALIM KA SAQT HAAT, HAIRAT HAIN KYUN NA PEHLE TAMACHE KE MARGAYI
MUDDAT TAMAM HOGAYI BANO KE CHAIN KI, AB TAK SADAYE ATI HAIN ZAINAB KE BAIN KI, AHSAN WO CHAR SAAL KI BACCHI HUSSAIN KI, TAZA LIYEE ZAMEER KA ELAAN KARGAYI
